Roasted Garlic & Jalapeño Hummus
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




15 ounces canned Garbanzo Beans
1 Jalapeño pepper
1 bulb garlic
4 tablespoons olive oil
1/2 teaspoon black pepper

Preparation

1 Preheat oven 350 degrees: 2 Wrap garlic bulb in tin foil and Jalapeño in tin foil and place in preheated oven. 3 Bake for about 25 minutes. 4 Remove garlic from skin. 5 Place garbanzo beans baked Jalapeño pepper (with seeds), roasted garlic, olive oil and black pepper in food processor.  Chop until a smooth texture is achieved.

About


This is a delightful dip or spread.
Enjoy!
